## Rule

**DECODED from generator `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_98cf29f8.py` (the "frog & fly / tongue" task). The metadata family "Pattern_Recognition / Filling Regions" is a FAMILY-LABEL MISNOMER (traps §FAMILY-LABEL).**

Each grid has exactly two solid rectangles of two distinct nonzero colours:
- **anchor** (`colors[0]`): a clean filled rectangle. Stays put.
- **mover** (`colors[1]`): a filled rectangle PLUS a 1-wide **tongue** line of the *same* colour bridging the gap toward the anchor.

Output: anchor unchanged; the tongue is erased; the mover rectangle **slides along the tongue axis until it is flush against the anchor** (it moves by exactly the tongue length). `flip`/`xpose` rotate the whole scene, so the tongue can point in any of the 4 directions. Verified 266/266 official + 10000/10000 fresh generator.

## Algorithm sketch

```
# per one-hot channel c (1..9): N=cellcount, rowsum[c,r]=sum over w
# anchor = filled rect; mover = NOT filled (rect+tongue). Filled-rect test (Cauchy-Schwarz,
# "all nonzero rows equal", exact for these shapes): filled <=> S3*N == S2*S2  where
#   N=sum rowsum, S2=sum rowsum^2, S3=sum rowsum^3   (all Einsum, in-kernel, no [1,10,30] tensor)
# A,M = anchor/mover colour values.  Projections (Einsum from input -> [1,30]):
#   a_r,a_c (anchor occ);  m_r_full/m_c_full (>0);  m_r_rect/m_c_rect (>1, tongue-free);  grid_r,grid_c
# moved axis = the one where full-span > rect-span (tongue contaminates it).
# flush run = ext (=rect span) cells adjacent to anchor on the mover's side.
# canvas[r,c] = A*a_r(x)a_c + M*m_r_out(x)m_c_out - 15*grid_r(x)grid_c + 15   (4-term rank-1 Einsum 'kr,kc->rc')
# output = Equal(canvas[30,30] f16, palette[1,10,1,1])  -> free BOOL one-hot; padding=15 -> all-0
```
Numpy reference + ONNX builder: `prototypes/build_task234_einsum_cs_flush.py`.

## Cost analysis

**CURRENT BEST = `task234_onegridproj_ramp_cost2289`** (memory 2226 + params 63; profile==static==2289). One-grid-projection ramp saves 118B vs `task234_where_k_cost2407`: delete the F32 `gcs` projection (120B) and old `gcs16` cast (60B), add `grid_w16 = ReduceMax(grs16)` (2B) and `gcs16 = grid_w16 - iota_r` (60B). The final decoder thresholds at `>0`, so the ramp is equivalent to an active-column mask: active columns are positive, padding columns are non-positive. Staged: `staged_submits/task234_onegridproj_ramp_cost2289/`.

Prior best: `task234_where_k_cost2407` (memory 2344 + params 63; profile==static==2407). K-row Where fold saved 40B vs `task234_cs_reorder_cost2447`: `Ka/Km = Where(is_anchor/is_mover, ones1, neg400_e0)` directly emits the final K rows and deletes the two F16 `[1,10]` casts `isa16` and `ism16`.

Residual at 2289:
- 5 input-reading projections `[1,30]` f32 = 600 (a/m row/col plus `grs`; F32-LOCKED per §INPUT-DTYPE-LOCK for the input-reading projections).
- Final free-output operand stacks: `Rmat/Cmat` `[3,30]` f16 = 360 total; `Kmat` `[3,10]` f16 = 60.
- F16 row/col masks and count casts: `mrr16`, `mcr16`, `a_r16`, `a_c16`, `grs16`, ramp `gcs16`, `flush16`, `m_r_out`, `m_c_out` = 540 total.
- CS classifier + F32 projection selectors: cellcount/S2/S3/lhs/rhs (200B F32) + eq_area/has/has_notch/is_anchor/not_eq/is_mover (60B BOOL) + isa/ism (80B F32) = 340B.
- K-row construction: `Ka/Km` two F16 `[1,10]` Where outputs = 40B. The `-400*e0` penalty is still required because the grid term is positive on foreground cells (now bounded by `width^2 <= 400`), not a strict boolean grid indicator.

No absolute floor claim. Further reduction would require: eliminating another F32 projection without losing padding-row/extent information, a cheaper CS test (no 2-moment test avoids materializing [1,10,30] rowsum), or shrinking K/R/C operand stacks (no mirror symmetry for #150). The prior kill-table still holds.

## Don't-do log

_Record ruled-out hypotheses here so future agents don't retry them._

- 2026-06-08 | Do NOT treat LIVE 8961 as hidden-lossy: measured LIVE = 4000/4000 on FRESH ARC-GEN generator (task_98cf29f8). Its historical 0/100 broad-adversarial was OFF-CONTRACT (shifted/noisy/extra-colour inputs that never occur in the real eval). task234 is a pure COST task, not a correctness-recovery task.
- 2026-06-08 | Do NOT use `Sigma rowsum^2 * Sigma colsum^2 == N^3` as a filled-rect test — it has false positives (movers coincidentally satisfy it: 13/266). The EXACT Einsum test is the Cauchy-Schwarz "all rows equal": `S3*N == S2*S2` (S3=sum rowsum^3). f32-exact for foreground (products < 16M); ch0 may overflow precision but is masked by notch0.
- 2026-06-08 | A CANVAS IS NOT NEEDED here — prefer the FREE-OUTPUT separable Einsum (2808 < 5010 canvas). My earlier "1800 canvas is the floor" was WRONG. When the output one-hot's channels are each rank-1 (or low-rank) in row/col indicators, build `output=Einsum('tk,tr,tc,b->bkrc', K, R, C, ones)` directly — the big tensor is in-kernel/free (#89), no canvas, no Equal-tail. Captured as technique #108.
- 2026-06-08 | (canvas-approach only; superseded) cropping the [30,30] canvas does NOT help: Equal+Pad materializes a charged [1,10,20,20] (4000); Pad-canvas-to-30 adds a 2nd [30,30] (2600). The 20x20 grid bound is real but only matters for a canvas design, which the free-output beats anyway.
- 2026-06-08 | Free-output ch0(background) handling: ch0 is the complement of the 2 boxes (NOT rank-1), but it IS rank-3: `grid - anchor - mover`. Fold the -anchor/-mover into the channel selectors: K=[is_anchor-e0, is_mover-e0, e0]. Padding falls out all-0 for FREE (grid_r(x)grid_c=0 outside the grid) — no sentinel needed.
- 2026-06-12 | Do NOT drop the foreground-channel `notch0` exclusion from the filled-rect classifier. The no-notch variant scored cheaper (2766) but visible failed 0/266 because background can enter the anchor/mover selectors.
- 2026-06-12 | Projection selectors cannot avoid F32 casts: BOOL selector Einsum is rejected (`unsupported type: tensor(bool)`), and F16 selector + F32 input is rejected as inconsistent type. The F32 `isa/ism` selector casts are forced by ONNX/ORT Einsum typing.
- 2026-06-20 | Do NOT try to eliminate `grs`/`gcs` projections by deriving from anchor+mover: the ARC-GEN generator always places anchors at rows[0]≥1, leaving row 0 (and trailing rows) as pure background. Background rows have a_rs=m_rs=0 but grs>0; no anchor+mover combination covers them. Superseded nuance (2026-06-23): one grid-axis projection can still be deleted by deriving `gcs16` from `grs16` width, not from anchor+mover.
- 2026-06-20 | Do NOT replace CS S3 Einsum with a 2-moment test: computing per-channel rowmax or nonzero-row-count requires materializing [1,10,30] F32 = 1200B (rowsum per channel), far exceeding the S3 Einsum cost (40B). No viable 2-moment shortcut found without this intermediate.
- 2026-06-20 | Do NOT attempt to derive grs_bool from (a_rs+m_rs>0): produces zero for pure-background rows inside the active grid, breaking the ch0 background plane for those rows.
- 2026-06-20 | Do NOT use a constant 400×(bool_grs)×(bool_gcs) as background: requires computing grs_bool (adds 30B BOOL intermediate), total 210B vs current 180B. WORSE.
- 2026-06-21 | Do NOT replace the `-400*e0` K-row penalty with `-e0`: visible fails 0/266. Since `grs` and `gcs` are active row/col counts, their product is active area (up to 400), so `grid - anchor - mover` leaves ch0 positive on foreground cells. The safe 40B win is the `Where(is_anchor/is_mover, 1, -400e0)` fold, not reducing the penalty magnitude.
- 2026-06-21 | Do NOT try to delete `m_rowmax16` with mixed-type `Greater(m_rowmax F32, wm F16)`: ONNX shape inference rejects `Greater` with inconsistent input type tensor(float16). Casting the other side to F32 is larger than the 2B scalar cast.
- 2026-06-23 | Do NOT derive active extent from literal `Shape(input)`: NeuroGolf encodes every task input as fixed `[1,10,30,30]`, while task234 active grids vary from 12 to 20. `Shape(input)` would mark trailing padding as active. The valid shrink is one-projection recovery: keep `grs`, derive width, and replace `gcs` with a threshold-equivalent F16 ramp.

- 2026-05-22 | Do not drop channel-0 background entirely: padding the 9 non-background channels directly scored ~27262 but failed raw full-tensor equality 0/266 because `convert_to_numpy` expects explicit channel-0 ones inside the visible rectangle.
- 2026-05-23 | Do not try all-`UINT8` color-index `Einsum`: `Mul(UINT8, UINT8)` is rejected by ONNX shape inference. Keep the weighted row side in F16 unless a different integer weighting op is found.
- 2026-05-23 | Do not use F16 `CumSum` below opset 14: opset 13 rejects it. The staged 18,124-cost candidate bumps to opset 14 before replacing the AveragePool prefix/suffix counters.
- 2026-05-23 | TopK active-color compression is valid for the official task234 set because every train/test/arc-gen pair has exactly two foreground colors; broad random adversarial inputs with more/noisy colors diverge from live and remain off-contract/advisory.
